objective.text: Get any living hero to the treasure at E3 without waking the giant. Noise starts at zero: each executed hero move adds 1, another hero ability adds 2, and a performance adds 3. Holding is silent. Finish the whole round at 12 noise or less, even if a hero reaches the treasure earlier in the round.
objective.victory_text: The treasure is yours. The giant sleeps on.
objective.defeat_text: The giant woke before the treasure was safely taken.
objective.victory_event: A hero quietly retrieves the treasure.
